pins.title: Five-day nature journal for kids: keep a dated record of one little habitat
pins.description: How can we tell which clues we saw on which visit? Return to the same little wildlife habitat over five days. Date each entry and record the weather, clues and visitors you notice. A parent, guardian or teacher can use an adult email to get the free Nature Tracker.
